status_note: Canon starter spell, ruled in by Roc 2026-08-05 as written.
learn_source: Watch the farmer winnow at the edge of the Town scene — a directed puff of air that does in one cast what an afternoon of tossing grain does by hand
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on loose material once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the gust is broad and sustained; at baseline it is one short puff. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: The chaff lifts and blows clear; clean grain stays in the tray
Scatter off the path in one gust
State-dependent: banked embers brighten and flare under the draft; dead ash only swirls — breath feeds fire, it does not start one
no_effect — the gust breaks around it and nothing moves
No physical effect — the gust parts around the animal without ruffling it
receivers.reaction_kind: startle-crouch, tail-lash, retreat to a doorway

receivers.physical_outcome: No physical effect — not a hair moves
receivers.reaction_kind: deflection — redirects the caster to the winnowing tray that actually needs it
